content: {"like":["Values emotional depth and powerful moments in storytelling","Prefers focused, well‑matched casts over large ensembles","Appreciates unique settings that avoid typical tropes (e.g., space without aliens)","Enjoys detailed, surprising subplots that reveal new layers on rewatch","Values high production quality and thoughtful packaging or extras"],"dislike":["Dislikes unrealistic or overly simplistic portrayals of justice or systems","Finds poorly executed endings that lack clear purpose frustrating","Criticizes narratives that rely on improbable or silly scenarios","Rejects characters who betray core values or become unlikable without justification","Avoids content with factual inaccuracies or lack of discipline among protagonists"]}
